name: 151. Cached content lifecycle, retrieval probes and legacy endpoints (cached content and retrieval pins)
description: Gemini cachedContents create/get/patch/list/generate/delete as one ordered lifecycle (cachePrefix is ~23k chars, over the 1k/4k-token minimums; the 5 minute ttl bounds a leaked entry if a middle case fails). Create/get/patch/delete bodies are carved out of the collection shape check in __skipShape because they carry no inference content. The Vertex lifecycle (151.7-151.9) is [PREVIEW]: it needs a real vertexProject, and the resource-name model form is best-effort until a live run. 151.10-151.12 are [EXPECT-4XX] live pins: googleSearchRetrieval (Gemini 2.x is expected to reject the legacy tool), and a nonexistent Vertex AI Search datastore / RAG corpus, each proving the field reaches Google. 151.13/151.14 probe the legacy /v1/complete route and batch results for an unknown id.

item.name: 151.1 gemini cachedContents create stores the long prefix (cached content crud)

pm.collectionVariables.set('h151CacheName', j.name);

item.name: 151.10 [EXPECT-4XX] vertex/gemini-2.5-flash legacy googleSearchRetrieval dynamicRetrievalConfig reaches Google (search grounding retrieval)

exec: pm.test('Google names the legacy retrieval tool in its rejection', function () { var t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t, 'rejection does not mention search/retrieval; field may not have reached Google: ' + t).to.match(/google.?search|retrieval|not supported/i); });

item.name: 151.11 [EXPECT-4XX] vertex/gemini-2.5-flash vertexAiSearch malformed datastore name reaches Google (vertex ai search grounding)

exec: pm.test('Google rejects the unknown datastore', function () { var t = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(t, 'a general auth or model-invocation refusal says nothing about the datastore: ' + t).to.not.match(/aiplatform\.endpoints\.predict|API key|API_KEY_INVALID|UNAUTHENTICATED|authentication credentials/i); pm.expect(t, 'rejection does not identify the submitted datastore: ' + t).to.match(/h149-not-a-datastore-resource-name|data.?store|vertex_?ai_?search/i); });

item.name: 151.13 [EXPECT-200] anthropic legacy /v1/complete with top_k on claude-opus-4-7 is served (text completions)

exec: // The legacy /v1/complete endpoint keeps top_k on post-Opus-4.6 models (only Messages rejects it), so Bifrost
// forwarding it (core/providers/anthropic/text.go) must still come back as a normal completion.
var j; try { j = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { j = null; }

pm.test('legacy completion with top_k is served', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); pm.expect(j, 'not JSON: ' + pm.response.text()).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(j.type, pm.response.text()).to.equal('completion'); pm.expect(j.completion, pm.response.text()).to.be.a('string').that.is.not.empty; });
